scope: Finite registered-sleeper notification capacity under the wait-registration mutex; not OS scheduling or speedup evidence.

cases.scope: A private-segment splice with a single signal can advertise less parallel work than the chunk count permits. A saturating local count selects min(eligible_chunks, processor_count-1) notifications under the existing registration mutex; no broadcast storm or host constant. All other processors are registered sleepers in this finite slice, no spurious wakeups; notification is not execution. Current VM processor count is fixed during the GC phase.
